name: Liverpool

queries.query: Liverpool HM Land Registry INSPIRE index polygons local authority open download full geometry
queries.scope: Verify city-specific official registered-parcel data and whether full polygons are publicly downloadable.
queries.result: HMLR’s current INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset lists Liverpool City Council as a local-authority download. The official dataset is indicative freehold registered-property footprint data and carries INSPIRE identifiers, not title extent/legal evidence. The WMS layer is map-only and GetFeatureInfo returns LayerNotQueryable. The direct download route redirected to a Cloudflare challenge; no challenge bypass was attempted and no geometry was extracted.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search and read-only service inspection.

queries.result: Official HMLR metadata identifies Liverpool in the monthly local-authority file distribution. Public WMS advertises INSPIRE parcel layer but marks it non-queryable, so it yields rendered maps rather than complete features.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search and read-only service inspection.
